display.purpose: Hero headlines only, one per view.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, index numbers, spec-table keys, tag text — metadata only, always mono uppercase.

shadows.name: shadow-flat
shadows.purpose: Reserved; not currently used on any shipped surface.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Reserved for future low-elevation overlay UI.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entrance / reveal easing — 'things reveal, they never bounce'.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action. Graphite fill at rest, signal cyan on hover — the accent's one permitted large-surface moment.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #0e1113; color: #faf8f4; border: 1px solid #0e1113; border-radius: 0; padding: 14px 22px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary span { display: inline-block; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #00a8e0; color: #0e1113; border-color: #00a8e0; } .ds-btn-primary:hover span { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00a8e0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent fill, inverts to solid graphite on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: transparent; color: #0e1113; border: 1px solid rgba(14,17,19,0.28); border-radius: 0; padding: 14px 22px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline span { display: inline-block; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #0e1113; color: #faf8f4; border-color: #0e1113; } .ds-btn-outline:hover span { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00a8e0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Tag
components.description: Interactive filter pill (e.g. project category filters). Solid inversion marks the active state.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #606060; border: 1px solid rgba(14,17,19,0.28); border-radius: 0; padding: 7px 12px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1), background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1); } .ds-tag:hover { border-color: #0e1113; color: #0e1113; } .ds-tag[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #0e1113; color: #faf8f4; border-color: #0e1113; } .ds-tag:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00a8e0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Underline-only field. No box, no radius — a single bottom rule that widens and turns signal cyan on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #606060; } .ds-input { font-family: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: #0e1113; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(14,17,19,0.28); border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 0; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1), border-width 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input:focus { border-bottom: 2px solid #00a8e0; padding-bottom: 11px; }

components.name: Assembly Row
components.description: One layer of a material breakdown (AssemblyStack) — index, name, material, thickness in mm. The system's most literal expression of 'the field report is the design.'
components.html: 03Tepelná izolaceEPS 150 ve spádu240 mm
components.css: .ds-assembly-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px 1fr auto 72px; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(14,17,19,0.12); transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1); } .ds-assembly-row:hover { background: #faf8f4; } .ds-assembly-index { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; color: #8a9195; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1); } .ds-assembly-row:hover .ds-assembly-index { color: #00a8e0; } .ds-assembly-name { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; color: #0e1113; } .ds-assembly-material { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #606060; text-align: right; } .ds-assembly-thickness { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #2b3134; }

components.name: Hero Diptych Panel
components.description: One half of the homepage hero (real HeroDiptych uses Framer Motion for the on-load rise/stagger and scroll parallax, both omitted here as static CSS can't express them — this snippet captures the resting look plus the hover state: photo scales 1.045, resting 25%-black tint lifts, signal-cyan top rule draws in).
components.html: 01—Střechy
components.css: .ds-hero-panel { position: relative; display: block; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1.2; text-decoration: none; } .ds-hero-panel-photo { position: absolute; inset: -32px 0; background: #2b3134 center/cover; transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-hero-panel:hover .ds-hero-panel-photo { transform: scale(1.045); } .ds-hero-panel-tint { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(14,17,19,0.25); transition: opacity 500ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.2,1); } .ds-hero-panel:hover .ds-hero-panel-tint { opacity: 0; } .ds-hero-panel-rule { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto 0; height: 2px; background: #00a8e0; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-hero-panel:hover .ds-hero-panel-rule { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-hero-panel-label { position: absolute; left: clamp(20px,5vw,72px); top: 2rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #faf8f4; } .ds-hero-panel-index { color: #00a8e0; } .ds-hero-panel-dash { color: #8a9195; }

narrative.overview: TATAI's interface reads like a report filed from the job site, not a brochure printed to sell one. The company's real working documents — layer breakdowns with measured thicknesses, numbered detail photos, a spec table per project — are the design language. Nothing here is decorative in the usual marketing sense: every visual device is doing the same job it does on an actual construction document, just rendered for the web. The system explicitly rejects the generic AI/SaaS landing page (gradient text, shadow-heavy cards, an eyebrow above every section, the hero-metric template) and glossy real-estate marketing (over-lit stock photography, aspirational tone) — TATAI's credibility comes from precision, not polish.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color used sparingly; everything else is graphite and paper.
Zero box-shadow anywhere in the codebase — depth is hairline rules and tonal shifts only.
Square corners everywhere except pills and two small-control radii (2px, 3px).
Monospace, uppercase, wide-tracked labels mark metadata only — never body copy.
Real numbers everywhere a claim could otherwise be vague: layer thickness in mm, Σ totals, year counts, project counts.
Motion runs on two curves only — ease-standard for state changes, ease-out for entrances — always transform/opacity, never bounce, always with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal cyan appears on rules, hovers, and single data points — never as a fill larger than a button. Its rarity is what makes it read as a signal instead of decoration.

rules.name: The No Pure White Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds are bone-100/bone-200, never #ffffff, except surface-card where a true white plate is needed against paper.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Metadata Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono never appears in a sentence a visitor reads for content — only in labels, numbers, and technical call-outs.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from a hairline or a change in surface tone, never from a shadow.

rules.name: The Reveal-Never-Bounce Rule
rules.body: Motion always eases out toward rest; it never overshoots or oscillates. If a curve has a bounce or elastic character, it's wrong for this system.

dos: Do keep signal-500 rationed to rules, hovers, and single data points.
Do use real numbers instead of adjectives wherever a claim can be shown instead of stated.
Do use JetBrains Mono uppercase exclusively for metadata.
Do keep every surface flat; depth is a hairline or a tone shift.
Do default to square corners; reserve radius for pills and the two smallest control radii only.
Do use warm paper backgrounds, never pure white, except the explicit surface-card plate.
donts: Don't use gradient text, shadow-heavy cards, or the hero-metric template.
Don't add a tiny uppercase eyebrow above every section reflexively.
Don't use over-polished, aspirational, lifestyle photography.
Don't add box-shadow to any component at rest.
Don't round card corners or box a list/grid item in a bordered container.
Don't let vague superlatives stand in for a number the company actually has.
